lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments traversing the torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section with a detectable decrease in inter-line pixel distance toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments at the far anterior (shoulder) and the two furthest posterior lines exhibit discontinuities, where lines terminate or fragment into discrete spots before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized grouping of approximately 7-9 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three discrete spots align horizontally across the mid-thigh, creating a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-contrast white spots are present on the malar region (cheek); a white transverse patch is visible on the lower neck; white bands are present on the lower legs above the hooves.
